subject: Qwen3-VL-2B on iPhone without the increased-memory-limit entitlement (iPhone batch item D2)

device.availableMemoryMiBAtStart: 3,368 (measured at launch in items A and C; the probe printed nothing before it aborted)

build: Examples/LanguageDevice (vision mode, one case photo-dog-portrait), the Qwen3-VL-2B one-function bundle registered for iOS (model fdda4278…, 4.29 GB staged); CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS pointed at an empty entitlements file on the command line, so the app ran at the default memory limit
outcome: The process aborted 8.7 s after launch, before the probe's first progress line ("session opened"): `libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::bad_alloc`, SIGABRT. The allocation that failed was MetalPerformanceShadersGraph's, during model specialization on Core AI's compiler queue (runtime canonicalization folding a transpose into a constant). It was neither a jetsam kill (the device logged no JetsamEvent for it) nor a refusal by Kit; the probe opens the session without resource admission. Kit cannot catch it: the abort happens inside Core AI's compiler.
